tagline: Real-time granular effect on the last 10 seconds of input
description: GranularEngine records its input into a 10-second buffer and plays it back as overlapping grains, up to 64 at a time. You set grain size, density, scan speed, read position, pitch, spray, reverse probability and stereo spread, and choose one of six grain windows. MIDI notes, when present, scale grain density by velocity.

features.name: Grain controls
features.description: Size 10-500 ms, density 1-100 grains per second, pitch -24 to +24 semitones

features.name: Scan Speed and Position
features.description: Scan Speed (0.25x to 4x) sets how fast grains move through the input; Position sets where in the buffer they read from

features.name: Spray, Reverse and Stereo Width
features.description: Spray scatters each grain's start point; Reverse is the chance a grain plays backwards; Stereo Width (0-200%) spreads grains at random across the stereo field

features.name: Six windows
features.description: Hann, Gaussian, Triangle, Tukey, Blackman and Kaiser, with a Shape control for Gaussian width and Tukey taper

features.name: Displays
features.description: Waveform of the 10-second buffer with the read position, a preview of the window, and grain activity, redrawn 60 times a second

features.name: Velocity-scaled density
features.description: While a MIDI note is held, grain density is multiplied by its velocity

useCases: Turn a sustained vocal or instrument into a grain cloud
Stutter and glitch textures with short grains and high spray
Slow, smeared versions of the input with Scan Speed below 1x
Octave-shifted textures with Pitch at ±12 semitones
